ne788b789c4.headline: Dubai stocks settle after trading turns briefly volatile
ne788b789c4.summary: Dubai stock markets settled after a brief period of volatility attributed to Emirates airline's latest results and the economic outlook affected by COVID-19.
ne788b789c4.why: Dubai's stock market reflects regional economic conditions; airline results and pandemic outlook influence investor sentiment in the Gulf region.
